title: Base → Solana USDC microbridge discovery. Default example uses 1.00 USDC deposit
description: Base → Solana USDC microbridge discovery. Default example uses 1.00 USDC deposited to the Base bridge wallet. Provide a Solana receiver address and an amount (min 0.01 USDC, max 50.00 USDC, steps of 0.01) to create a concrete bridge quote. The bridge charges a 2.5% commission; the remainder is delivered as USDC on Solana.
